Hana: Noticed a set of invoices from the A/B pricing experiment where grandfathering didn't apply for accounts created before rollout. Example: INV-9110 billed full rate not legacy tier.
Marco: Which cohort? A or B?
Hana: This affected cohort-B (early access alpha). Looks like the CSV we pushed had a missing 'grandfather_until' column for cohort-B price rows.
Diego: Yikes. Any customers impacted > $500? We need controller sign-off if so.
Hana: Two invoices > $500; one is $620. Total impact ~ $980.
Priya: Policy: individual credits under $1k can be applied by billing ops. I'll approve.
Marco: Plan: 1) Apply credits to the two invoices; 2) re-upload manifest with corrected column; 3) run sample reconcile for 48h to catch any more misses; 4) add playbook checkbox.
Hana: Commands I'll run (dry-run first):
```
billing-cli prices upload --manifest gs://redwood-prod/manifests/ab-cohort-v1.csv --dry-run
billing-cli invoices reconcile --invoice INV-9110 --dry-run
billing-cli credits create --invoice INV-9110 --amount 120 --reason "grandfathering backfill" --dry-run
```
Priya: Hold 30m for customer comms. I'll sign once message approved.
Diego: I'll set an automated monitor to scan invoices over next 72h for cohort-B mapping mismatches and alert #finance if any > $200.
BillingBot: INV-9110 generated 2026-04-02 08:12 UTC. Status: paid. Credit operations will place negative line items when applied.
Hana: Thanks. I'll post the customer email draft here before we send. Also updating the rollout checklist to include required columns and a schema validator.
Marco: Good. After credits applied, please tag FIN-2468 and close the loop with a short postmortem.
Hana: Will do. :white_check_mark:
